title: Test beat 100 BPM (procedural)
author: hygen engine (engine/py/make_test_beat.py)
notes: Test track for sync: music — 100 BPM, 30 bars of 4/4 (72 s): kick on every beat (downbeat louder, bass note), clap on 2 and 4, hats on eighths, a soft Am–F–C–G pad. Seeded noise, the same file every run. Not for publication: a test of the beat grid. No third-party content.
